question: During a multi-second EGO camera_pose take gap, does the EGO participant UDP socket continue returning receive calls while the topic reader history remains empty?

attempts.evidence: The 2.487916 s take gap was captured, but the run-local EGO launch action replaced the outer LD_PRELOAD with librmw_wait_probe.so; no EGO meter CSV was produced.
The EGO PID environment and maps verified both preload libraries and the prefix; shutdown did not invoke the meter dump path, so no receive count was used.
The EGO meter opened its PID file, but run cleanup did not explicitly signal the tracked EGO PID; the CSV remained zero bytes after container teardown.

The EGO preload and file prefix were verified before motion. After CTF stop, run cleanup sent SIGTERM directly to EGO PID 498; the signal-safe summary contained 70,680 successful receive API calls and aligned with the selected take gap.

configuration.fastdds_profile: Run-local FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE profile requests listenSocketBufferSize=212992 bytes; actual EGO socket rb=425984 bytes.

configuration.meter_output: Per-PID CSV with bucket counts, returned byte totals, and errors; no receive buffer contents are read or persisted.

capture_scope.what_is_counted: Successful libc receive API calls and returned byte totals on the socket bound to UDP 62427.
capture_scope.qualification: The participant socket carries multiple DDS streams. These calls cannot be attributed to camera_pose or to a specific RTPS sample.

socket_receive_meter.interpretation: Counts are successful libc receive API calls observed on the EGO UDP socket bound to port 62427. They do not identify DDS topics or prove payload delivery to a DataReader. Fully contained 10 ms buckets give a conservative lower count; all overlapping buckets give an upper count because boundary buckets are only partially aligned.

trace_integrity.ctf_sha256_check: all 32 data/index files verified by sha256sum -c analysis/ctf-file-hashes.sha256

interpretation: The long EGO camera_pose take gap was reproduced while both the adapter and an independent reader continued delivering pose data, and MapStatus remained ready with stable epoch/map_id. The EGO participant UDP socket returned at least 2,540 receive API calls in fully contained 10 ms buckets during the gap (2,623 calls across all overlapping buckets). This rules out a complete absence of receive API activity on that participant socket, but does not identify those calls as camera_pose traffic or prove RTPS insertion into the EGO DataReader history. Kernel socket drops also increased by 140 during the gap; no topic-level cause is established.
limitations: Receive counters are participant-socket-wide and do not classify topic or RTPS sample; no packet payload was read.
The 10 ms bucket boundary yields a conservative lower count and an upper count including both partial boundary buckets.
Global wait trace continuity failed because sequences 110–116 are missing outside the selected gap; selected-window alignment and CTF hashes passed.
Only one corrected in-process counter run is usable; the earlier #356–#358 attempts are preserved but excluded from receive-count conclusions.
The map transition is a diagnostic snapshot only; the planner spline was not executed, and no vehicle-clearance, controller, PX4, truth, or hardware evidence was produced.
